results.question: Какова средняя цена товаров в каждой категории? Покажи название категории и среднюю цену в копейках, округлённую до целого.

    c.name AS category_name,
    CAST(AVG(p.price_cents) AS INTEGER) AS average_price_cents
FROM

    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY 
    c.name
results.final_sql:

FROM

results.question: Какова минимальная, максимальная и средняя цена активных товаров? Среднюю округли до целого. Покажи три значения в копейках.

    MIN(p.price_cents) AS min_price_cents,
    MAX(p.price_cents) AS max_price_cents,
    ROUND(AVG(p.price_cents)) AS avg_price_cents
FROM 
    products p
WHERE 
    p.is_active = 1;
results.final_sql:

    MIN(p.price_cents) AS min_price_cents,
    MAX(p.price_cents) AS max_price_cents,
    ROUND(AVG(p.price_cents)) AS avg_price_cents
FROM 
    products p
WHERE 
    p.is_active = 1;

results.question: Сколько заказов оформил каждый покупатель из Киева, включая тех, у кого заказов нет? Покажи имя и количество.
results.initial_sql:
SELECT 
    c.full_name,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    customers c
LEFT JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND c.city = 'Киев'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY 
    order_count DESC, c.full_name;
results.final_sql:
SELECT 
    c.full_name,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    customers c
LEFT JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND c.city = 'Киев'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY 
    order_count DESC, c.full_name;

results.question: Сколько единиц товаров купили покупатели каждого города в доставленных заказах? Покажи город и количество.
results.initial_sql:
SELECT 
    c.city,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_units
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'delivered' AND s.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    c.city
ORDER BY 
    total_units DESC, c.city;
results.final_sql:
SELECT 
    c.city,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_units
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'delivered' AND s.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    c.city
ORDER BY 
    total_units DESC, c.city;

results.question: Каков средний рейтинг товаров каждого поставщика? Покажи название поставщика и рейтинг, округлённый до двух знаков.
results.initial_sql:
WITH avg_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        p.supplier_id,
        AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM
        products p
    JOIN
        reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
    GROUP BY
        p.supplier_id
)
SELECT
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    CAST(avg_ratings.avg_rating AS NUMERIC(10, 2)) AS rounded_avg_rating
FROM
    avg_ratings
JOIN
    suppliers s ON avg_ratings.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
ORDER BY
    rounded_avg_rating DESC;
results.final_sql:

    SELECT
        p.supplier_id,
        AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM
        products p
    JOIN
        reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
    GROUP BY
        p.supplier_id
)
SELECT
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    CAST(avg_ratings.avg_rating AS NUMERIC(10, 2)) AS rounded_avg_rating

    avg_ratings

results.question: Какие платежи были успешно проведены в июне 2025 года? Покажи номер платежа, номер заказа и сумму.
Сколько заказов оформлено в каждом месяце 2025 года? Покажи месяц в формате ГГГГ-ММ и количество.
results.initial_sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM 
    orders
WHERE 
    ordered_at LIKE '2025-%'
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month;
results.final_sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM 
    orders
WHERE 
    ordered_at LIKE '2025-%'
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month;
